# Agent decision, not a person's review (2026-11-12): at-oemo is now the final round of the Austrian olympiad, and its earlier rounds have their own codes, as the official papers at oemo.at show. A label with no part, "Federal Competition For Advanced Students", holds the papers of part 1 in 2015 and 2017, as the official papers show. "Austrian MO National Competition" holds both parts of the federal competition in one collection with no numbers, and the booklets of hf-mathnet hold several rounds, so their rows give no position.

# Census of Western, Northern and Central Europe (2026-11-16), the United Kingdom, Ireland, France and the Benelux; Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Italy, Spain and Portugal; the Nordic and Baltic countries; Poland, Czechia, Slovakia, Hungary, Slovenia and Croatia. Agent decision, not a person's review: each label below goes to the round or contest that it names, now that the rounds, junior olympiads, selection tests and regional contests of the region have their own codes. A label that names a training set (the French envois), a mix of rounds, or a round name that several countries share ("Second Round") goes to "-". The samples of hf-mathnet decided the plain round names: "School Round", "First Round (take-home)" and "District Round" are Czech and Slovak papers of categories A and B, "TANDA", "Problemas Primera Sesión" and the January date are the Spanish local phase, "Maarttoets" is the Dutch BxMO and EGMO test of March, and "UMI SNS Progetto Olimpiadi di Matematica" mixes the February and Cesenatico papers. The plain labels "Italy", "France" and "Switzerland" are hf-mathnet rows with no competition, which take the name of the country; the samples hold papers of several rounds, so they go to "-".
